question: How many singers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM singer

question: What are all the names and countries of singers?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Country FROM singer

question: What is the average age of all singers?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Age) FROM singer

question: What are the names of all stadiums?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM stadium

question: How many stadiums are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stadium

question: What is the maximum capacity among all stadiums?
gold_sql: SELECT max(Capacity) FROM stadium

question: What is the average and maximum capacity of all stadiums?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Capacity), max(Capacity) FROM stadium

question: List all singer names in descending order of age.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Age DESC

question: What is the name and age of the youngest singer?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Age FROM singer ORDER BY Age ASC LIMIT 1

question: Show the name and the release year of the song by the youngest singer.
gold_sql: SELECT Song_Name, Song_release_year FROM singer ORDER BY Age ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the name and capacity of the stadium with the highest capacity?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY Capacity DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the stadium name and the number of concerts held in each stadium.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, count(*) FROM stadium AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.Stadium_ID = T2.Stadium_ID GROUP BY T1.Name

question: List the names of singers who have been in more than one concert.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING count(*) > 1

question: Find the names of concerts and their corresponding stadium names.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.concert_Name, T2.Name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.Stadium_ID = T2.Stadium_ID

question: Find the name and age of singers whose age is greater than the average age of all singers.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Age FROM singer WHERE Age > (SELECT avg(Age) FROM singer)

question: Find the names of stadiums that have never held a concert.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Stadium_ID NOT IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM concert)

question: Find singer names who did not participate in any concert.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert)

question: List the name and capacity of stadiums that have hosted more than one concert.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T1.Capacity FROM stadium AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.Stadium_ID = T2.Stadium_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING count(*) > 1

question: Find the names of singers who have appeared in both a 2014 and a 2015 concert.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_ID = T3.concert_ID WHERE T3.Year = '2014' INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_ID = T3.concert_ID WHERE T3.Year = '2015'

question: Find the country with the most singers.
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM singer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many car makers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM car_makers

question: List all countries and their continents.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.CountryName, T2.Continent FROM countries AS T1 JOIN continents AS T2 ON T1.Continent = T2.ContId

question: What are the full names of all car makers?
gold_sql: SELECT FullName FROM car_makers

question: How many cars were made in 1970?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM cars_data WHERE Year = 1970

question: What is the average MPG of all cars?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(MPG) FROM cars_data

question: What is the maximum and minimum horsepower of all cars?
gold_sql: SELECT max(Horsepower), min(Horsepower) FROM cars_data

question: What are the car makes and their models?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Make, T2.Model FROM car_names AS T1 JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Model = T2.ModelId

question: What is the number of car models made by each car maker?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName, count(T2.ModelId) FROM car_makers AS T1 JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.FullName

question: List the car make and year for all cars with more than 6 cylinders.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Make, T2.Year FROM car_names AS T1 JOIN cars_data AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id WHERE T2.Cylinders > 6

question: Find the car with the highest MPG and return its make.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Make FROM car_names AS T1 JOIN cars_data AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id ORDER BY T2.MPG DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many car makers are there in each continent?
gold_sql: SELECT T3.Continent, count(*) FROM car_makers AS T1 JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId JOIN continents AS T3 ON T2.Continent = T3.ContId GROUP BY T3.Continent

question: What is the average weight of cars made in 1970?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Weight) FROM cars_data WHERE Year = 1970

question: What is the average horsepower of cars made in 1970?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Horsepower) FROM cars_data WHERE Year = 1970

question: What is the average MPG of cars made in the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(T1.MPG) FROM cars_data AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.MakeId JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Model = T3.ModelId JOIN car_makers AS T4 ON T3.Maker = T4.Id JOIN countries AS T5 ON T4.Country = T5.CountryId WHERE T5.CountryName = 'USA'

question: Which countries have more than 1 car maker?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.CountryName FROM car_makers AS T1 JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId GROUP BY T2.CountryName HAVING count(*) > 1

question: What are the makers and models of cars with an MPG greater than the average MPG?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.FullName, T3.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T4 ON T1.Id = T4.MakeId JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T4.Model = T3.ModelId JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T3.Maker = T2.Id WHERE T1.MPG > (SELECT avg(MPG) FROM cars_data)

question: Find the average horsepower of cars grouped by number of cylinders, only for cylinder counts with average horsepower above 100.
gold_sql: SELECT Cylinders, avg(Horsepower) FROM cars_data GROUP BY Cylinders HAVING avg(Horsepower) > 100

question: Find car makers that do not have any cars in cars_data.
gold_sql: SELECT FullName FROM car_makers WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT T1.Maker FROM model_list AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.ModelId = T2.Model JOIN cars_data AS T3 ON T2.MakeId = T3.Id)

question: Find the country that has the maker with the most models.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.CountryName FROM car_makers AS T1 JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.Maker GROUP BY T2.CountryName ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find car makers that have models with 4 cylinders and also models with 8 cylinders.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.FullName FROM cars_data AS T1 JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ModelId JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.Maker = T3.Id WHERE T1.Cylinders = 4 INTERSECT SELECT T3.FullName FROM cars_data AS T1 JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ModelId JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.Maker = T3.Id WHERE T1.Cylinders = 8

question: How many countries are in Europe?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe'

question: What are the names of all countries in Asia?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia'

question: What is the total population of all countries?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) FROM country

question: What is the average life expectancy in Europe?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe'

question: List all cities and their population.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Population FROM city

question: What is the name and population of the most populous city?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Population FROM city ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the names and populations of countries with a population greater than 100 million?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Population FROM country WHERE Population > 100000000

question: List the official languages and the countries that speak them.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.IsOfficial = 'T'

question: Find the names of countries and their capital city names.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T2.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.Capital = T2.ID

question: What is the number of languages spoken in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT CountryCode, count(*) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode

question: What continent has the highest total GNP?
gold_sql: SELECT Continent FROM country GROUP BY Continent ORDER BY sum(GNP) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List all cities in Europe with a population greater than 1 million.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Continent = 'Europe' AND T2.Population > 1000000

question: What is the average life expectancy for countries grouped by continent?
gold_sql: SELECT Continent, avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country GROUP BY Continent

question: Find countries with life expectancy above average.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy > (SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country)

question: List the top 3 most populous countries by continent.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Continent, Population FROM country ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find countries that have no official language recorded.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE IsOfficial = 'T')

question: List country names where the capital city's population is more than 1 million.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.Capital = T2.ID WHERE T2.Population > 1000000

question: Find the total number of cities in countries with a population above 50 million.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM city AS T1 JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T2.Population > 50000000

question: Find countries where English is an official language but French is not.
gold_sql: SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' AND IsOfficial = 'T' EXCEPT SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'French'

question: List the top 3 countries with the highest number of cities.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, count(T2.ID) AS city_count FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name ORDER BY city_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many employees are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM employee

question: List all employee names and their ages.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Age FROM employee

question: What is the name and location of each shop?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Location FROM shop

question: What is the average age of all employees?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Age) FROM employee

question: What is the total bonus given to employee with ID 1?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(Bonus) FROM evaluation WHERE Employee_ID = '1'

question: List shops with more than 400 products.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM shop WHERE Number_products > 400

question: What is the name of the manager of the shop in New York?
gold_sql: SELECT Manager_name FROM shop WHERE Location = 'New York'

question: List the names of full-time employees.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM employee AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Employee_ID = T2.Employee_ID WHERE T2.Is_full_time = 1

question: What shops and how many employees does each one have?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, count(T2.Employee_ID) FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Shop_ID GROUP BY T1.Name

question: Find the total bonus received by each employee.
gold_sql: SELECT Employee_ID, sum(Bonus) FROM evaluation GROUP BY Employee_ID

question: List the names and cities of employees who work in a shop in New York.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T1.City FROM employee AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Employee_ID = T2.Employee_ID JOIN shop AS T3 ON T2.Shop_ID = T3.Shop_ID WHERE T3.Location = 'New York'

question: What is the average bonus per year for all evaluations?
gold_sql: SELECT Year_awarded, avg(Bonus) FROM evaluation GROUP BY Year_awarded

question: Find the name and age of the oldest employee.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Age FROM employee ORDER BY Age DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the average bonus awarded in 2021.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Bonus) FROM evaluation WHERE Year_awarded = '2021'

question: Find employee names who have received a bonus above average.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM employee AS T1 JOIN evaluation AS T2 ON T1.Employee_ID = CAST(T2.Employee_ID AS INTEGER) WHERE T2.Bonus > (SELECT avg(Bonus) FROM evaluation)

question: Which employees have never been evaluated?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM employee WHERE Employee_ID NOT IN (SELECT CAST(Employee_ID AS INTEGER) FROM evaluation)

question: What is the total bonus for employees hired before 2021?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(T2.Bonus) FROM hiring AS T1 JOIN evaluation AS T2 ON T1.Employee_ID = CAST(T2.Employee_ID AS INTEGER) WHERE T1.Start_from < '2021-01-01'

question: Find the shop with the most employees.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Shop_ID GROUP BY T1.Name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List shops that have both full-time and part-time employees.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Shop_ID WHERE T2.Is_full_time = 1 INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Shop_ID WHERE T2.Is_full_time = 0

question: Find the names of employees who received a bonus in 2021 but not in 2022.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM employee AS T1 JOIN evaluation AS T2 ON T1.Employee_ID = CAST(T2.Employee_ID AS INTEGER) WHERE T2.Year_awarded = '2021' EXCEPT SELECT T1.Name FROM employee AS T1 JOIN evaluation AS T2 ON T1.Employee_ID = CAST(T2.Employee_ID AS INTEGER) WHERE T2.Year_awarded = '2022'

question: How many students are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Students

question: List all first and last names of students.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM Students

question: How many courses are available?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Courses

question: List all course names and descriptions.
gold_sql: SELECT course_name, course_description FROM Courses

question: What are the email addresses of all students?
gold_sql: SELECT email_address FROM Students

question: How many transcripts have been issued?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transcripts

question: What cities do students currently live in?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.city FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id = T2.address_id

question: How many students are enrolled in each degree program?
gold_sql: SELECT degree_program_id, count(*) FROM Student_Enrolment GROUP BY degree_program_id

question: What is the number of student enrolments per semester?
gold_sql: SELECT semester_id, count(*) FROM Student_Enrolment GROUP BY semester_id

question: List the first names and email addresses of students who have left.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, email_address FROM Students WHERE date_left IS NOT NULL

question: Find students who registered after 2019.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM Students WHERE date_first_registered > '2019-12-31'

question: List students and their current city.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.city FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id = T2.address_id

question: How many transcript contents are there for each transcript?
gold_sql: SELECT transcript_id, count(*) FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY transcript_id

question: Find the number of enrolments for each student.
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, count(*) FROM Student_Enrolment GROUP BY student_id

question: Find the first and last names of students who have a transcript.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN Transcript_Contents AS T3 ON T2.student_enrolment_id = T3.student_enrolment_id

question: What is the number of students who do not have any enrolment?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Student_Enrolment)

question: Find the state or province of addresses used by enrolled students.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.state_province_county FROM Student_Enrolment AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN Addresses AS T3 ON T2.current_address_id = T3.address_id

question: List the number of students per city.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.city, count(*) FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id = T2.address_id GROUP BY T2.city

question: Find students who registered in 2018.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM Students WHERE date_first_registered LIKE '2018%'

question: List students who are enrolled in more than one semester.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(DISTINCT T2.semester_id) > 1
